items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: He lives with Santiago. He lives at Santiago's house.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, sure. I've met him, yeah, sure. Carol Levine.

Because I used to teach out there too, yeah. He was also in the band. Yeah, sure, I know. He was the dean of the band too. No. No, this is my wife's youngest brother. He's a bass player. Him and I were playing bass together. Now, this is son Johnson. Who is? Arthur Johnson. You know him too. You know Aubin. That's me. Where are you then? That's Emil Frick. He doesn't play anymore. That's Emil Maurice. He's still acting. That's Black's friend. He lives with Santiago. He lives at Santiago's house. He's a drum player.
